title: Paloma Business Plan Schedule: Subscription Fees and Billing Cycles
content:
Every Paloma Business plan carries a subscription fee in US dollars. The monthly fee is the fee for one monthly billing period; the annual fee is the fee for one annual billing period; and each plan states whether it may be billed annually at all.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly fee (USD per monthly billing period) | 0.00 | 19.00 | 49.00 | 129.00 | 299.00 | 749.00 |
| Annual fee (USD per annual billing period) | 0.00 | 190.00 | 490.00 | 1290.00 | 2990.00 | 7490.00 |
| Annual billing available | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Reading the schedule

- **Plan with no annual option.** Paloma Business Starter may not be billed annually; its monthly fee is 0.00 USD.
- **Plans with an annual option.** Paloma Business Essentials, Growth, Pro, Scale and Enterprise may each be billed monthly or annually, at the monthly or annual fee shown in their own column.
- **One column per account.** An account's fees are read from the column of the plan the account is on.

### Points of reference

| Question about the schedule | Answer from the table |
|---|---|
| Fee for one monthly billing period on Paloma Business Growth | 49.00 USD |
| Fee for one annual billing period on Paloma Business Pro | 1290.00 USD |
| Whether Paloma Business Starter offers annual billing | No |
| Monthly fee on Paloma Business Enterprise | 749.00 USD |
